key_insight: Scenario-Actor adapts LLM sampling temperature from an interpretable geometric embedding of the communicative scenario, instead of using a fixed global heuristic.
engineering_relevance: This offers a practical decoding control mechanism for deployment settings where output randomness should match the interaction context, improving task success without changing the base model.
method: Extract scenario-relevant structure from Transformer hidden states.
Build a structured scenario embedding that geometrically represents the communicative setting.
Map the embedding to a decoding temperature for context-adaptive generation.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports strong goal-completion in interactive social scenarios, significant gains on open-ended instruction following, and competitive multi-turn conversation results on Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct versus multiple baselines.
watch_item: Performance depends on reliably inferring the scenario from hidden states, so misclassification or brittle scenario embeddings could lead to poorly tuned temperatures.
paper_title: Read the Room Before Your Model Generates
